Independent check via falling factorial moments and factorization of 4B₃²−3B₂B₄
correctness.rationale: For N complete circuits the pgf is (1−p)z/(1−pz). In x=p/(1−p), its falling factorial moments are k!x^(k−1)(1+x) for k≥1, with the continuous value at x=0. Conditional on N the jth scaled moment λ^j μ_j is the mean of the rising product (sN)(sN+1)…(sN+j−1). Converting ordinary powers of N to falling factorials through degree four gives the listed B_j and the lower-order ratio μ₂/μ₁². Independently, multiplication gives 4B₃²−3B₂B₄=(s²−1)[(s+1)(s+2)+6sx]. Thus 4/3−R is this affine numerator divided by 3B₃². For B₃=A+Bx+Cx² and the reduced numerator L=A+6sx, the coefficients of 2B₃′L−6sB₃ are (2B−6s)A, 6sB+4CA, and 18sC, all positive. This proves strict monotonicity and yields the endpoint (s+3)/(s+2) at x=0 and limit 4/3 as x diverges. The leading term is K_s x⁻³, K_s=(s²−1)/(18s³); analyticity in 1−p at zero gives dr/dp∼3K_s(1−p)² and the stated inverse derivative, not merely an inversion of a big-O statement. The given mean then fixes λ; arbitrary quadruples still require the other moment equations. For 0<p<1 the transform numerator is a nonzero constant and there is a nonreal root of the denominator for s≥3, ruling out any finite acyclic representation with a real triangular transient generator. At p=0 the law is Erlang and acyclic.
residual_risks: The inversion is for known s and the specified statistic. The frozen rational tests are finite spot checks; the factorization and sign proof hold without those tests.

A distinct indexed three-phase result does contain the equal-mean benchmark at s=3; it does not give the all-s inverse and cubic law. value.rationale: The ratio is a standard adjacent moment diagnostic (H_3), not an arbitrary polynomial chosen to have a singular endpoint. The result gives an exact compatibility interval and quantifies the specific loss of conditioning near an exponential-like endpoint, including the rate and constant. The contrast with affine identification from the first two moments is useful because it prevents incorrectly attributing that instability to the whole two-parameter model. The distinct contribution is the diagnostic's complete behavior within this motivated cyclic family, not a universal fitting method.
residual_risks: No finite-sample error guarantee or new method for optimally estimating the family from all moments is implied.
